Stage 2: under the pass-measure rule that scales the first two limits to the reproduced count and rounds down, failures_found becomes main loses at most 7 of 164 pairs (8 x 82/87 = 7.54) and key_bugs_demoted becomes at most 2 in main (3 x 82/87 = 2.83); Stage 5 applies these.

Controls agents used copies of them, and Stage 3 audits will too.

Stage 2: controls agents ran on claude-opus-5-5 at high effort with the audit tools and a 40-minute clock; their clocks read 1 to 5 minutes because they shared container slots with the reproducers and slot waits do not count.

Stage 2: the h2 controls agent wrote probe files to the scratchpad folder Claude Code gives each session; that folder is outside the workspace but inside the agent's own session folder, which Claude Code allows writing. check_runs.py now exempts the agent's own session folder, and no agent read anything outside its workspace.
Stage 2: one decoy (h2 decoy-1) has a cause_rule that names the triggering input rather than a cause; it is still confirmed false, so it was kept as written.
